dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ほんとに、無理しないほうがいいよ」
dialogues.en: "...You shouldn't overexert yourself."
dialogues.text: "...You shouldn't overexert yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だって……コホッ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine... *cough*..."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine... *cough*..."

dialogues.jp:
小さく咳き込む工藤に、ことりが心配そうな表
情を見せる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was looking worriedly over Kudou, who was coughing
several times.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was looking worriedly over Kudou, who was coughing
several times.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、工藤。風邪はもういいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, Kudou. Your cold's okay now?"
dialogues.text: "Ohh, Kudou. Your cold's okay now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.jp:
……と答えつつもその顔色はどことなく青白く、
声も微妙にかすれて聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
...He answered as his face was still pale, and his voice
barely audible.
dialogues.text:
...He answered as his face was still pale, and his voice
barely audible.

dialogues.jp: （ふうん、本当に体調崩してたのか……）
dialogues.en: "(Hm, he really does look bad...)"
dialogues.text: "(Hm, he really does look bad...)"

dialogues.jp: なにが宇宙人だ、杉並の阿呆め。
dialogues.en: What space alien eh, Suginami.
dialogues.text: What space alien eh, Suginami.

dialogues.jp: 無理をおして出てきたのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Isn't he pushing himself too hard though?
dialogues.text: Isn't he pushing himself too hard though?

dialogues.jp:
辛そうに時折、咳をもらす工藤の姿はいつもよ
り小さく見えた。
dialogues.en: I took a small glance at Kudou's pained figure.
dialogues.text: I took a small glance at Kudou's pained figure.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっといいか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you mind?"
dialogues.text: "Do you mind?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Wah!?"
dialogues.text: "Wah!?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤の額に手を伸ばして、自分と熱を比べ
てみた。
dialogues.en:
I put my hand on his forehead, and compared his heat to
mine.
dialogues.text:
I put my hand on his forehead, and compared his heat to
mine.

dialogues.jp:
本来ならば音夢の場合のように額同士をくっつ
けるべきなのであろうが、男同士でそれは少々
デンジャラスゾーンだ。
dialogues.en:
With Nemu, I'd do it forehead-to-forehead, but with two
guys, that's going too far into the danger zone.
dialogues.text:
With Nemu, I'd do it forehead-to-forehead, but with two
guys, that's going too far into the danger zone.

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅむ……」
工藤の額は、心なしか熱いような気がする。
dialogues.en: His forehead was definitely warmer than it should be.
dialogues.text: His forehead was definitely warmer than it should be.

dialogues.jp:
「お前、まだ熱あるみたいだぞ。調子悪いなら
　早退するか保健室行くかしたほうがいいんじゃ
　ないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Your forehead is still hot. If you're feeling bad, you
should go to the doctor's office, you know."
dialogues.text:
"Your forehead is still hot. If you're feeling bad, you
should go to the doctor's office, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「大袈裟だな……このくらいどうってこと無い
　……コホコホッ」
dialogues.en:
"That's exaggerating... I don't need to go there... *cough
cough*."
dialogues.text:
"That's exaggerating... I don't need to go there... *cough
cough*."

dialogues.jp: 言葉の途中で再びせきこむ。ほら見ろ。
dialogues.en:
His talking was interrupted by his coughs. Just look at
that...
dialogues.text:
His talking was interrupted by his coughs. Just look at
that...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君の言うとおりだよ、そんな状態じゃ倒
　れちゃうかもしれないもの」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun's right. At this point, you're going to
collapse..."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun's right. At this point, you're going to
collapse..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりも横から俺の意見に賛同した。それでも
工藤は迷うような素振りを見せている。
dialogues.en:
Kotori agreed with me from the sidelines. Kudou started to
look lost.
dialogues.text:
Kotori agreed with me from the sidelines. Kudou started to
look lost.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「かったるい奴だな、ほれ、行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "What a troublesome idiot. Come on, let's go."
dialogues.text: "What a troublesome idiot. Come on, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「わっ」
dialogues.en: "Wah!"
dialogues.text: "Wah!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤の腕を掴んで。半ば強引に保健室まで
つれて行くことにした。
dialogues.en: I grabbed Kudou's arm, and half-pulled him to the infirmary.
dialogues.text: I grabbed Kudou's arm, and half-pulled him to the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
物珍しそうに過ぎ行く学生達の目が気になるの
か、工藤はしきりと俺の手から逃れようとした。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to the curious stares from other students, Kudou kept
trying to escape my hand's grasp.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to the curious stares from other students, Kudou kept
trying to escape my hand's grasp.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だ、大丈夫だって言ってるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "I, I told you I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "I, I told you I'm fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「残念ながら俺は、そういった自己申告はいっ
　さい信用しないことにしてるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Too bad, I don't trust self-examinations when it comes to
things like this."
dialogues.text:
"Too bad, I don't trust self-examinations when it comes to
things like this."

dialogues.jp: ……そういう嘘つきが身近に一人いたからな。
dialogues.en: ...Someone close to me would always lie like that as well.
dialogues.text: ...Someone close to me would always lie like that as well.

dialogues.jp:
そう、あいつはいっつも、「大丈夫だよ兄さん」
なんて言うくせに、その実、全然大丈夫じゃな
いんだ。
dialogues.en:
Yeah, she's always "I'm fine, nii-san.", even though the
truth is as far from that as you could get.
dialogues.text:
Yeah, she's always "I'm fine, nii-san.", even though the
truth is as far from that as you could get.

dialogues.jp: 思い出して、少し笑いそうになってしまった。
dialogues.en:
As that memory drifted through my mind, a small smile formed
on my lips.
dialogues.text:
As that memory drifted through my mind, a small smile formed
on my lips.

dialogues.jp: がらっ、と勢いよく保健室のドアを開く。
dialogues.en: I opened the door to the infirmary with haste.
dialogues.text: I opened the door to the infirmary with haste.

dialogues.jp: 「急患一丁！」
dialogues.en: "Emergency, Block 1!"
dialogues.text: "Emergency, Block 1!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉………………よせって」
dialogues.en: "Asakura....... stop that."
dialogues.text: "Asakura....... stop that."

dialogues.jp: 俺のあげた声に、工藤が恥ずかしげに袖を引く。
dialogues.en:
Kudou tugged at my sleeve, trying to get me to lower my
voice.
dialogues.text:
Kudou tugged at my sleeve, trying to get me to lower my
voice.

dialogues.jp:
なにやら名簿のようなものを調べていた小柄な
女性――保健のゆき先生が顔をあげて答えた。
dialogues.en:
Inside was a short woman holding a register of names--
Yuki-sensei, the doctor in charge of the infirmary.
dialogues.text:
Inside was a short woman holding a register of names--
Yuki-sensei, the doctor in charge of the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
ゆき先生には付属時代から音夢のことでよく世
話になった。
dialogues.en:
I talked to her a lot, as I always brought Nemu here when we
were part of the attached school.
dialogues.text:
I talked to her a lot, as I always brought Nemu here when we
were part of the attached school.

dialogues.jp:
小柄で童顔だが、とても頼りになる優しい先生
だ。
dialogues.en:
She was short and had a childlike face, but she's a very
gentle and reliable sensei.
dialogues.text:
She was short and had a childlike face, but she's a very
gentle and reliable sensei.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？　あら、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Oh, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Oh, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: にっこりと笑うゆき先生に俺も笑顔を返す。
dialogues.en: She smiled as she saw me.
dialogues.text: She smiled as she saw me.

dialogues.jp: 「今日は別件ですよ、サボリでもないです」
dialogues.en: "Today's a different case, not the usual."
dialogues.text: "Today's a different case, not the usual."

dialogues.jp:
「こいつが体調悪いみたいなんで、少し寝かせ
　てやってくれませんか」
dialogues.en:
"This guy here has been feeling poorly, can he rest here for
awhile?"
dialogues.text:
"This guy here has been feeling poorly, can he rest here for
awhile?"

dialogues.jp:
拾ってきたネコのように、工藤の首根っこを持
ち上げて指し示す俺。
dialogues.en:
As if I was holding a cat, I lifted Kudou's head to face
Yuki-sensei.
dialogues.text:
As if I was holding a cat, I lifted Kudou's head to face
Yuki-sensei.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、工藤君」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Kudou-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Kudou-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……お世話になっています」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry for being a bother."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry for being a bother."

dialogues.jp:
……なんだ工藤、先生に名前覚えられるほど保
健室の常連なのか？
dialogues.en:
...Kudou, are you such a regular visitor that the doctor
knows you by name?
dialogues.text:
...Kudou, are you such a regular visitor that the doctor
knows you by name?

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp:
「確かに顔色が悪いわ、取りあえず、横になっ
　た方がよさそうね」
dialogues.en: "Your face looks very bad, indeed. Come over here first."
dialogues.text: "Your face looks very bad, indeed. Come over here first."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「すみません」
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと熱を測ってみて」
dialogues.en: "I'd check your temperature."
dialogues.text: "I'd check your temperature."

dialogues.jp:
そう言ってゆき先生は戸棚から古式ゆかしい水
銀式の体温計を一本取り出してきた。
dialogues.en:
As she talked, she took a mercury thermometer from her
cupboard.
dialogues.text:
As she talked, she took a mercury thermometer from her
cupboard.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes."

dialogues.jp: 工藤が頷いて制服のボタンに手をかける。
dialogues.en: Kudou nodded as his hands went to his shirt buttons.
dialogues.text: Kudou nodded as his hands went to his shirt buttons.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま手を止めて、何か気遣わしげに俺を見
やった。
dialogues.en:
"His hands suddenly stopped, and he looked at me with fear
in his eyes.
dialogues.text:
"His hands suddenly stopped, and he looked at me with fear
in his eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかしたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp: ゆき先生は工藤と視線を合わせ、小さく頷いた。
dialogues.en:
Yuki-sensei exchanged a quick glance with Kudou, and nodded
slightly.
dialogues.text:
Yuki-sensei exchanged a quick glance with Kudou, and nodded
slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉君、後は私にまかせて、もう教室に
　戻っていいわよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Asakura-kun, let me handle things from here. You can go
back to your class."
dialogues.text:
"...Asakura-kun, let me handle things from here. You can go
back to your class."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そう、ですか？……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? I, is that so?..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? I, is that so?..."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「もう授業始まっちゃうから、ね」
dialogues.en: "Lessons are going to start soon."
dialogues.text: "Lessons are going to start soon."

dialogues.jp:
がらがら、ピシャンと大きな音を立てて目の前
のドアは閉められた。
dialogues.en:
Yuki-sensei lightly pushed me out of the room, and shut the
door behind her.
dialogues.text:
Yuki-sensei lightly pushed me out of the room, and shut the
door behind her.

dialogues.jp: なんか……急に追い出されたよーな気がするが。
dialogues.en:
Huh... sounds like she wanted to chase me out for another
reason.
dialogues.text:
Huh... sounds like she wanted to chase me out for another
reason.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく手持ち無沙汰で、わしゃわしゃと頭
を｛か／掻｝く。
dialogues.en: A few weird ideas started running through my head...
dialogues.text: A few weird ideas started running through my head...

dialogues.jp: 「……まぁ、いいか」
dialogues.en: "...Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "...Well, whatever."

dialogues.jp: とりあえず俺の任務はここまでか……。
dialogues.en: In any case, my duty ends here...
dialogues.text: In any case, my duty ends here...

dialogues.jp: 「任務完了！」
dialogues.en: "Mission complete!"
dialogues.text: "Mission complete!"

dialogues.jp: びしっと意味なく敬礼なぞを決めてみた。
dialogues.en: I gave a mock salute in front of the infrimary.
dialogues.text: I gave a mock salute in front of the infrimary.

dialogues.jp:
その途端に、タイミング良く鳴り響く始業のベ
ル。
dialogues.en:
And perfectly timed, the bell signifiying the start of
classes rang.
dialogues.text:
And perfectly timed, the bell signifiying the start of
classes rang.

dialogues.jp: 「ぅおっと！　やばい、やばい」
dialogues.en: "Whoa! I might not make it!"
dialogues.text: "Whoa! I might not make it!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は慌てて廊下を駆け出したのだった。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly dashed down the corridor.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly dashed down the corridor.

dialogues.jp: ◆過保護症候群◆
dialogues.en: ◆Excessive Care Syndrome◆
dialogues.text: ◆Excessive Care Syndrome◆

dialogues.jp:
まだ体調が悪いくせに無理をしているような工
藤。
dialogues.en:
Kudou returned to school, but he was obviously exerting
himself too much.
dialogues.text:
Kudou returned to school, but he was obviously exerting
himself too much.

dialogues.jp:
そんな工藤に業を煮やした俺は、強引に保健室
に連れていくのだった。
dialogues.en: Seeing him so pained, I brought him to the infirmary.
dialogues.text: Seeing him so pained, I brought him to the infirmary.

dialogues.jp: まったく、かったるい奴だ。
dialogues.en: Seriously, what a troublesome idiot.
dialogues.text: Seriously, what a troublesome idiot.
